crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t…
Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

translations.web: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translations.bsb: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translations.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
translations.asv: How is it that ye do not perceive that I spake not to you concerning bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
